title: 67 Fast Track Special Courts, Including 56 Exclusive POCSO Courts, Functional in Madhya Pradesh.
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Law and Justice

67 Fast Track Special Courts, Including 56 Exclusive POCSO Courts, Functional in Madhya Pradesh.

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
25 JUL 2026 8:57PM by PIB Delhi

As per the information made available by the High Court of Madhya Pradesh,
67 Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs), including 56 exclusive POCSO Courts, are functional
 under the Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Fast Track Special Courts (FTSCs). Of these,
two FTSCs, including one exclusive POCSO Court, are functional in Ratlam district
,
 while
one FTSC is functional in Jhabua district
, for the expeditious disposal of cases relating to rape and offences under the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act. No FTSC is functional in Alirajpur district.

The number of cases instituted, disposed of and pending before the FTSCs, including exclusive POCSO Courts, in Ratlam and Jhabua districts during the last two years is as under:

District

Year

Cases Instituted

Cases Disposed

Cases Pending*

Ratlam

2024

472

260

691

2025

343

338

696

Jhabua

2024

266

135

418

2025

231

154

495

* Pending as on 31st December of the respective years.

The establishment of District and Subordinate Courts, including Special Courts, falls within the administrative domain of the respective State Governments, in consultation with the High Courts concerned. Accordingly, the setting up of additional FTSCs is considered by the State Government in consultation with the concerned High Court, keeping in view the pendency of eligible cases and the availability of resources. At present, no proposal for setting up additional FTSCs is under consideration of the Government in the said Parliamentary Constituency.

This information was given by the Union Minister of Law and Justice, Shri Arjun Ram Meghwal Ji, in a written reply to the Lok Sabha.

***

Samrat/PN/Sagar
